# Privacy Statement — DevTools Desktop

At **[shakeelahamedofficial]**, we believe in building tools that respect your privacy and data security. 

## 1. Local Processing
DevTools Desktop is designed as an **offline-first** application. 
- All data processed by the JSON, JWT, Base64, URL, UUID, Hash, Timestamp, Regex, and SQL tools occurs **entirely locally on your machine**.
- Your input is never sent to our servers.

## 2. Network Activity
The application only connects to the internet in the following intentional scenario:
- **HTTP Client Tool**: When you explicitly instruct the HTTP tool to make a web request, it will connect directly to the destination URL you provided.
- The application does **not** make any phone-home, update-check, or telemetry requests on startup or during use.

## 3. Data Storage
- Application settings (such as theme preferences and window size) and a list of your recently used tools are saved locally using your operating system's native settings storage mechanism.
- No historical data of your inputs (e.g., JSON text, HTTP request bodies) is saved by the application unless you manually use the "Export" or "Save" functions to save a file to your disk.

## 4. No Telemetry or Analytics
DevTools Desktop contains **zero telemetry** and **zero analytics**. We do not track how often you use the app, which tools you use, or any usage metrics whatsoever.

For any questions regarding your privacy, please contact us at: https://buymeacoffee.com/shakeelahamedofficial
